GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Bis bald" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. thank you
   B. please
   C. very good
   D. see you soon

2. It is seven o'clock in the evening and you arrive at a friend's house. What do you say? (1 mark)
   A. Guten Morgen
   B. Auf Wiedersehen
   C. Gute Nacht
   D. Guten Abend

3. What does "das Radio" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. window
   B. radio
   C. table
   D. shower

4. What does "im" stand for? (1 mark)
   A. in der
   B. an dem
   C. in die
   D. in dem

5. What does "das Fenster" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. table
   B. bathroom
   C. window
   D. bed

6. What does "der Apfel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. potato
   B. fish
   C. apple
   D. banana

7. What does "das Abendessen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. onion
   B. supper
   C. water
   D. watermelon

8. What does "der Finger" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tummy
   B. finger
   C. foot
   D. toe

9. What does "das Gewitter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. rainbow
   B. thunderstorm
   C. sky
   D. rain

10. How is the letter S named in German? (1 mark)
   A. tset
   B. enn
   C. emm
   D. ess

11. Which word is said with the sound "eye"? (1 mark)
   A. heute
   B. nein
   C. Schule
   D. Tier

12. Which German name belongs to the mark "!"? (1 mark)
   A. das Fragezeichen
   B. das Ausrufezeichen
   C. der Punkt
   D. das Komma

13. What does "die Schwester" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. daughter
   B. brothers and sisters
   C. sister
   D. aunt

14. What does "das Zimmer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fork
   B. fridge
   C. room
   D. table

15. What is the plural of "die Gabel"? (1 mark)
   A. die Gabeln
   B. die Gabels
   C. die Gabel
   D. die Gabeler

16. Which little word goes with the noun "Bett"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. der
   D. den

17. Which day comes right before Donnerstag? (1 mark)
   A. Mittwoch
   B. Freitag
   C. Sonntag
   D. Dienstag

18. What does "Freunde" mean? (1 mark)
   A. families
   B. days
   C. friends
   D. foods

19. What does "jetzt" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. now
   B. often
   C. always
   D. yesterday

20. Which month comes right after "Mai"? (1 mark)
   A. Juni
   B. November
   C. Januar
   D. März

21. What does "die Party" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. birthday
   B. party
   C. cake
   D. song

22. Which month is "Dezember"? (1 mark)
   A. September
   B. November
   C. December
   D. October

23. Which little word goes with the noun "Fisch"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. den
   C. der
   D. das

24. What does "die Mango" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. mango
   B. water
   C. potato
   D. cabbage or kale

25. Which little word goes with the noun "Mittagessen"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. der
   C. das
   D. den

26. What does "die Hand" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. leg
   B. hand
   C. finger
   D. shoulder

27. What does "trocken" mean? (1 mark)
   A. dry
   B. wet
   C. cold
   D. hot

28. What does "der Regenbogen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fog
   B. snow
   C. cloud
   D. rainbow

29. Which German word means "between"? (position word) (1 mark)
   A. hinter
   B. neben
   C. zwischen
   D. auf

30. Which form completes "Du ___ nett"? (1 mark)
   A. bin
   B. sind
   C. bist
   D. ist

31. Which German word or phrase means "window"? (1 mark)
   A. das Fenster
   B. der Herd
   C. das Haus
   D. die Uhr

32. Which verb fits in "Am Sonntag ___ ich in die Kirche"? (1 mark)
   A. gehst
   B. gehen
   C. geht
   D. gehe

33. What do you hear in a word if it is spelled "ei"? (1 mark)
   A. the sound oy
   B. the sound eye
   C. the sound ow
   D. the sound ee

34. What does "der erste" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. seventh
   B. sixth
   C. first
   D. third

35. What does "der fünfte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. seventh
   B. third
   C. sixth
   D. fifth

36. What does "Februar" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. February
   B. March
   C. October
   D. August

37. Which German word or phrase means "rice"? (1 mark)
   A. die Mango
   B. die Wassermelone
   C. die Banane
   D. der Reis

38. What is the plural of "das Ei"? (1 mark)
   A. die Eier
   B. die Eien
   C. die Eie
   D. die Eis

39. Which little word goes with the noun "Kakao"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. der
   D. den

40. How do you ask "Where is the ball?" (1 mark)
   A. Wo ist der Ball?
   B. Wer ist der Ball?
   C. Wie ist der Ball?
   D. Was ist der Ball?

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write three sentences about the weather in German. (3 marks)

42. Read: "In Mombasa ist es heiß." Say what it means and how to say heiß. (2 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: balloon, arm, sister, shoulder. (4 marks)

44. Write the German words with der, die or das for: head, eye, mouth, hand. (4 marks)

45. Write the German birthday wish "All the best for your birthday". (2 marks)

46. Rewrite correctly: "guten abend otieno" (2 marks)

47. Write the German words with der or die for: father, mother, brother, sister. (4 marks)

48. Describe a floor plan of your dream house in German. Name at least three rooms. (3 marks)

49. Write in German what you do on Saturday. Start with "Am Samstag". (2 marks)

50. Give two reasons why fruit and vegetables are good for the body. (2 marks)

51. Explain how to say the letters z, w and v in German words. Give one example each. (3 marks)

52. Write the German words with der, die or das for: foot, head. (2 marks)

53. Write these numbers in German: 1, 15, 20. (3 marks)

54. Read: "Der Herd ist heiß. Das Messer ist scharf." Explain what the text warns about. (2 marks)

55. Explain the difference in sound between "ie" and "ei" and give one example day for each. (3 marks)

56. Write the German words with der, die or das for: present, aunt, mango. (3 marks)

57. A child arrives at school in the morning. Write in German what the child says to the teacher, and how the teacher asks how the child is, and the child's answer. (4 marks)

58. Read: "Kamau hat Geburtstag. Er ist zehn Jahre alt." Say in English who has a birthday and how old he is. (2 marks)

59. Write the German words with der, die or das for: grandfather, plate. (2 marks)

60. Write the German words with der, die or das for: finger, brothers and sisters, wind. (3 marks)

61. Read: "Mein Vater heißt Juma. Er ist groß und nett." Write three facts from the text in English. (3 marks)

62. Give two reasons why imitating a teacher or a recording helps when learning German sounds. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — see you soon
   Bis bald means see you soon.

2. D — Guten Abend
   Abend means evening. Gute Nacht is only for going to bed and Auf Wiedersehen is for leaving.

3. B — radio
   das Radio means radio.

4. D — in dem
   im is the short form of in dem.

5. C — window
   das Fenster means window.

6. C — apple
   der Apfel means apple.

7. B — supper
   das Abendessen means supper.

8. B — finger
   der Finger means finger.

9. B — thunderstorm
   das Gewitter means thunderstorm.

10. D — ess
   In German the letter S is called ess.

11. B — nein
   The letters ei sound like the English word eye.

12. B — das Ausrufezeichen
   ! is the exclamation mark, das Ausrufezeichen.

13. C — sister
   die Schwester means sister.

14. C — room
   das Zimmer means room.

15. A — die Gabeln
   The plural of die Gabel is die Gabeln.

16. B — das
   It is das Bett, so the little word is das.

17. A — Mittwoch
   Before Donnerstag comes Mittwoch.

18. C — friends
   der Freund is friend and die Freunde is friends.

19. A — now
   jetzt means now.

20. A — Juni
   After Mai comes Juni.

21. B — party
   die Party means party.

22. C — December
   Dezember is the last month of the year.

23. C — der
   It is der Fisch, so the little word is der.

24. A — mango
   die Mango means mango.

25. C — das
   It is das Mittagessen, so the little word is das.

26. B — hand
   die Hand means hand.

27. A — dry
   trocken is dry.

28. D — rainbow
   der Regenbogen means rainbow.

29. C — zwischen
   between in German is zwischen.

30. C — bist
   du goes with bist.

31. A — das Fenster
   window in German is das Fenster.

32. D — gehe
   ich goes with gehe.

33. B — the sound eye
   ei sounds like eye.

34. C — first
   der erste means first.

35. D — fifth
   der fünfte means fifth.

36. A — February
   Februar means February.

37. D — der Reis
   rice in German is der Reis.

38. A — die Eier
   The plural of das Ei is die Eier.

39. C — der
   It is der Kakao, so the little word is der.

40. A — Wo ist der Ball?
   wo means where.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Heute ist es sonnig. Es ist warm. Der Wind weht.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: In Mombasa it is hot. heiß is said like hice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Luftballon, der Arm, die Schwester, die Schulter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Kopf, das Auge, der Mund, die Hand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the words and 1 mark for correct spelling and punctuation.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guten Abend, Otieno!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for capital letters and 1 mark for punctuation.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Vater, die Mutter, der Bruder, die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each noun with the correct article.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das ist die Küche. Das ist das Wohnzimmer. Das ist das Schlafzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each room correctly named.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Am Samstag spiele ich Fußball.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Am Samstag, 1 mark for a correct sentence.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: They give vitamins and energy; they help us to stay healthy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: z is ts (Zahl), w is v (Wasser), v is f in most words (Vater).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sound and example.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Fuß, der Kopf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: eins, fünfzehn, zwanzig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cooker is hot and the knife is sharp, so we must be careful in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each warning.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: ie sounds like ee (Dienstag); ei sounds like eye (Freitag).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sound and 1 mark for correct examples.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Geschenk, die Tante, die Mango.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: Guten Morgen! Wie geht's? Gut, danke.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Guten Morgen, 1 mark for Wie geht's?, 1 mark for Gut, danke, 1 mark for capital letters and punctuation.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kamau has a birthday and he is ten years old.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fact.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Opa, der Teller.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

60. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Finger, die Geschwister, der Wind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

61. (3 marks)
   Answer: The father is called Juma. He is tall. He is kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fact.

62. (2 marks)
   Answer: We hear the right sounds and practise them again and again, so our mouth learns them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.
